An 88-vertex totient realization of the four-stage contracted nanostar: a counterexample to the Ghanbari-Alikhani nanostar conjecture (arXiv:2012.12492; Math. Gazette 2023)

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

Ghanbari-Alikhani final conjecture: no nanostar grown at least four stages is a G_phi-graph. False at stage 4: 23 explicit generators give an 88-vertex orbit tree with centre 1024 isomorphic to D_4.

AI-assisted research preprint. The scoped main statement has a Lean certificate. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for exact qualifications and formalization limits.
